header.name: Priya Sharma
header.headline: Senior Product Manager | B2B SaaS | Payments & Fintech Platforms

experience.title: Senior Product Manager, Merchant Payments
experience.context: Series D fintech serving 2M+ small and mid-size merchants.
bullets: Recurring payments: Launched UPI AutoPay and e-mandate flows, adding Rs 1,200 Cr in annual processed volume within 12 months.
Onboarding: Redesigned merchant KYC journey with a team of 14, cutting activation time from 5 days to 36 hours and lifting conversion by 22%.
Risk: Built a real-time fraud rules dashboard with the risk team, reducing chargeback losses by 31% year on year.
Mentored 3 associate PMs and set up a quarterly OKR process adopted across the payments org.

experience.title: Product Manager, Billing Platform
bullets: Owned the subscription billing product for 900+ enterprise clients; grew ARR from Rs 18 Cr to Rs 41 Cr.
Introduced usage-based pricing and invoicing APIs, shortening enterprise integration time by 40%.
Ran 25+ A/B tests on checkout and dunning flows, recovering 9% of previously failed payments.

experience.title: Business Analyst
bullets: Gathered requirements and wrote specifications for a core banking upgrade for a UK retail bank.
Built SQL reporting packs used weekly by client leadership to track migration progress.

certifications: Certified Scrum Product Owner (CSPO), Scrum Alliance, 2020
achievements: Speaker at Global Fintech Fest 2024 on recurring payments for small businesses.
Led the hackathon team that built PayNova's first WhatsApp payment link prototype, now a live product.
summary: Senior Product Manager with 8+ years building B2B SaaS and payments products used by 2M+ merchants across India. Led end-to-end launches of UPI AutoPay, merchant onboarding and risk dashboards, growing processed volume by 3x in two years. Combines strong data and SQL skills with a track record of aligning engineering, design, compliance and sales teams around clear outcomes. Seeking to drive platform strategy for a high-growth fintech.
